# opnsense_acmeclient_action (Resource)

Manages an ACME Client restart action in the OPNsense os-acme-client plugin. The schema focuses on `configd_restart_gui`; other action types remain available via the OPNsense UI and are preserved on update.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_acmeclient_action" "reload_gui" {
  name        = "reload-web-gui"
  description = "Reload the OPNsense web GUI after certificate renewal"
  type        = "configd_restart_gui"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name for the restart action.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description for this restart action.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this restart action. Defaults to `true`.
- `type` (String) Action type. Defaults to `configd_restart_gui`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the restart action.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import opnsense_acmeclient_action using the `id`. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_acmeclient_action.example
  id = "<opnsense-resource-id>"
}
```

Using `terraform import`, import opnsense_acmeclient_action using the `id`. For example:

```console
% terraform import opnsense_acmeclient_action.example <opnsense-resource-id>
```
